framework.name: CISA CPG
framework.description: CISA Cross-Sector Cybersecurity Performance Goals - baseline cybersecurity practices for critical infrastructure

controls.title: Asset Inventory
controls.description: Better identify known, unknown (shadow), and unmanaged assets, and more rapidly detect and respond to new vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Leadership
controls.description: A single leader is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity within an organization.

controls.title: OT Cybersecurity Leadership
controls.description: A single leader is responsible and accountable for OT-specific cybersecurity within an organization with OT assets.

controls.title: OT Cybersecurity Improvements
controls.description: Improve OT cybersecurity and more rapidly and effectively respond to OT cyber incidents.

controls.title: Mitigate Known Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Reduce the likelihood of threat actors exploiting known vulnerabilities to breach organizational networks.

controls.title: Validate Cyber Defenses
controls.description: Identify TTPs that lack proper defenses and establish confidence in organizational cyber defenses.

controls.title: Vendor Incident Notification
controls.description: Organizations more rapidly learn about and respond to known incidents or breaches across vendors and service providers.

controls.title: Vendor Vulnerability Notification
controls.description: Organizations more rapidly learn about and respond to vulnerabilities in assets provided by vendors and service providers.

controls.title: Secure Procurement
controls.description: Reduce risk by buying more secure products and services from more secure suppliers.

controls.title: Change Default Passwords
controls.description: Prevent threat actors from using default passwords to achieve initial access or move laterally in a network.

controls.title: Minimum Password Strength
controls.description: Organizational passwords are harder for threat actors to guess or crack.

controls.title: Unique Credentials
controls.description: Attackers are unable to reuse compromised credentials to move laterally across the organization, particularly between IT and OT networks.

controls.title: Revoke Credentials for Departing Staff
controls.description: Prevent unauthorized access to organizational accounts or resources by former employees.

controls.title: Separate User and Privileged Accounts
controls.description: Make it harder for threat actors to gain access to administrator or privileged accounts, even if common user accounts are compromised.

controls.title: Network Segmentation
controls.description: Reduce the likelihood of threat actors accessing the OT network after compromising the IT network.

controls.title: Unsuccessful Login Attempts
controls.description: Protect organizations from automated, credential-based attacks.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Add a critical, additional layer of security to protect assets accounts whose credentials have been compromised.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Training
controls.description: Organizational users learn and perform more secure behaviors.

controls.title: OT Cybersecurity Training
controls.description: Personnel responsible for securing OT assets received specialized OT-focused cybersecurity training.

controls.title: Strong Encryption
controls.description: Effective encryption deployed to maintain confidentiality of sensitive data and integrity of IT and OT traffic.

controls.title: Sensitive Data Protection
controls.description: Protect sensitive information from unauthorized access.

controls.title: Email Security
controls.description: Reduce risk from common email-based threats, such as spoofing, phishing, and interception.

controls.title: Macro Security
controls.description: Reduce the risk from embedded macros and similar executive code, a common and highly effective threat actor TTP.

controls.title: Incident Response Planning
controls.description: More efficiently and effectively manage, respond to, and recover from cyberattacks against the organization and maintain service continuity.

controls.title: Incident Response Testing
controls.description: More efficiently and effectively respond to cyberattacks and maintain service continuity.

controls.title: Hardware and Software Approval
controls.description: Increase visibility into deployed technology assets and reduce the likelihood of breach by users installing unapproved hardware, firmware, or software.

controls.title: System Backups
controls.description: Organizations reduce the likelihood and duration of data loss at loss of service delivery or operations.

controls.title: Incident Response Plan Maintenance
controls.description: Organizations maintain, practice, and update cybersecurity incident response plans for relevant threat scenarios.

controls.title: Log Collection and Storage
controls.description: Achieve better visibility to detect and effectively respond to cyberattacks.

controls.title: Log Protection
controls.description: Organizations' security logs are protected from unauthorized access and tampering.

controls.title: Portable Media Security
controls.description: Prevent malicious actors from achieving initial access or data exfiltration via unauthorized portable media devices.

controls.title: Secure Internet-Facing Assets
controls.description: Unauthorized users cannot gain an initial system foothold by exploiting known weaknesses in public-facing assets.

controls.title: OT Internet-Facing Asset Protection
controls.description: Reduce the risk of threat actors exploiting or interrupting OT assets connected to the public internet.

controls.title: Detect Relevant Threats and TTPs
controls.description: Organizations are aware of and able to detect relevant threats and TTPs.

controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.description: CISA and other organizations are better able to provide assistance or understand the broader scope of a cyberattack.

controls.title: Vulnerability Disclosure
controls.description: Organizations more rapidly learn about vulnerabilities or weaknesses in their assets discovered by security researchers; researchers are more incentivized to responsibly share their findings.

controls.title: Vulnerability Reporting
controls.description: Allow security researchers to submit discovered weaknesses or vulnerabilities faster.

controls.title: Incident Recovery Planning
controls.description: Organizations are capable of safely and effectively recovering from a cybersecurity incident.
